title: Enterprise Connectivity: availability target percentage
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following availability target percentage for each named contract tier. Monthly availability percentage above which no outage credit is due; decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | availability target percentage | 99.9 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | availability target percentage | 99.9 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | availability target percentage | 99.9 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | availability target percentage | 99.9 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | availability target percentage | 99.9 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | availability target percentage | 99.9 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the availability target percentage is 99.9.
